sio2_melting_1.name: Melting of SiO2 - Level 1
sio2_melting_1.description: Simulate the melting of SiO2 by heating under NPT conditions using the Tersoff potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Monitor the Si–O bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase transition where the first RDF peak shows a significant change, defined as more than 10% increase from the initial value. Report the average Si–O bond length in the molten state in Å.
